user_requirement: Always present a concrete integration proposal based on recommendations and wait for explicit approval before applying changes.
method: Five fresh collaboration.spawn_agent contexts per arm; four cases clustered in each run. Controls receive cases only; baseline and candidate receive cases plus their complete SKILL.md and release-workflow.md. All controls and baseline runs completed before candidate authoring. Frozen rubric, manual non-blinded controller scoring; one candidate revision.
actor_model: Inherited runtime default without overrides; exact model and reasoning identifiers not exposed by the spawning tool.
harness: Codex desktop collaboration API; exact harness build unavailable from tool result.
actor_scope: Micro actors may read only assigned inputs and save their response; no scenario actions, other skills, agents or sibling results. Each actor saved its final response directly in its assigned output file.
action_trials: Two further fresh candidate-only actors perform actual Git/filesystem work in separate disposable repositories; pending first request versus previously approved unchanged proposal. No network or publication; fixture policy and supplied approval are synthetic.
limits: Five independent runs per arm, not twenty; cases within each actor are correlated.
Small synthetic prompt-level sample; scoring is manual and non-blinded.
Action trials are candidate-only coverage, not comparative efficacy evidence.
No real v7.0.1 integration, other-harness, long-conversation, cost or latency measurement.
Complete underlying tool traces are not exported; retained final responses and controller Git inspections are the available evidence.
historical_evidence: Parent evaluation directory describes the original skill at the baseline commit. It remains historical evidence; this change supersedes its initial integration-authorization shortcut.
response_formatting: All responses are byte-identical to actor output except candidate-3.md, whose extra terminal blank line is removed for Git whitespace checks. Exact candidate-3 original text and SHA256 are retained in outputs/candidate-3.raw.json; scoring is unchanged.
